item.description:
**Requires macOS 13 Ventura or later.** Macs on macOS 12 stay on 0.4.0.
### New
- **odiff comes with the app** — pixel diffs and the timeline's change indicators work out of the box, without installing odiff from Homebrew. - **About and Acknowledgements** — the Golden Browser menu now has **About** (the version, and links to the website, terms and privacy policy) and **Acknowledgements** (the open-source software inside the app and its licences), plus **Settings…**, **Hide** and **Quit**. The links to the terms and privacy policy are also under Settings → Account. - **⌘,** opens Settings; holding **⌘** shows it on the settings button.
### Improved
- Signing out frees this Mac's place in your account's machine limit, so you can sign in on another Mac straight away, without signing this one out on the website. - Your sign-in is kept in the macOS Keychain. - When the app can't confirm your licence, the lock screen says why: the licence server can't be reached, the app is too old for your licence, your Mac's clock is off, or the licence couldn't be verified. A failed sign-in is explained in plain words.
### Fixed
- After signing in, the menu bar had no **Quit**, **Hide** or **About**, and **⌘Q** did nothing. - The licence is checked again when it expires, even if the app stays open in front the whole time.

### New
- **Grid view** — see many goldens side by side in place of the preview: a golden's variants, every golden in a folder, or all of them with **Grid overview** at the top of the sidebar, which also shows as you move onto it, like a golden does. Open the grid with **G**, the **Grid** button at the end of the preview toolbar, a folder's grid button, or a right-click menu. While it's open the grid follows the sidebar — click or W/S onto a folder or a golden and the grid shows it — until **G**, **Esc** or **Close grid**. Click a tile to open that image in the preview. - The grid has its own timeline: every commit that changed its goldens, with how many changed between the chips. Pick A and B there to see each tile at A, its change against B beside its name, and the diff overlay and **Find diff pixels** on every tile. - **Grid in review mode** — the grid shows a review's changed images, compared between the review's two sides. A deleted golden shows faded at its old version. - **LFS goldens in the grid** — a tile that isn't downloaded has a **Load** button, and a bar above the grid offers **Load all** and **Always load in this project**. - **Hold ⌥, ⌘ or ⌃ to see shortcuts** — after half a second, every button with a shortcut shows its keys underneath, and the sidebar, timeline, preview and grid list the keys that act on them, until you let go. - **Sort the grid** from the first buttons in its toolbar, or cycle with **R**: as in the sidebar, changed first, or biggest change first, where added and deleted images lead and a golden's variants can part. - The single preview now has the diff overlay (mask or only the differing pixels), **Find diff pixels** and the crosshair, like side-by-side.
### Improved
- **Q** / **E** keep the selected commit in the middle of the timeline, together with B while you compare against it. - **Enter** now also expands and collapses the focused folder, like **Space**, and both open Grid overview when it's focused. - The crosshair always snaps to image pixels, so there's one crosshair button instead of smooth and pixel-snap ones, and **X** turns it on and off. - The branch picker works from the keyboard: **↑** / **↓** move through branches and tags, or the search's matches, and **Enter** picks one. - The branch button gives its whole width to the branch name, with HEAD as a small badge on its corner; in the picker, HEAD sits at the end of its row, where a remote's name does.
### Fixed
- Switching branches could break the sidebar with errors until the app was restarted. - Switching back to the app reloaded what it showed every time, visibly; it now refreshes only when the repo changed meanwhile. - With thousands of goldens, Grid overview's timeline and sorting by biggest change no longer freeze the app.

### New
- **Updates from inside the app** — when a new version is out, a button appears next to **Back to projects**, or next to Settings on the welcome and sign-in screens. It shows what's new, downloads the update in the background, and installs it when you restart Golden Browser, or the next time you quit. This version still needs `brew upgrade --cask golden-browser`; later ones arrive in the app.
